bugFixes.description: Fixed a bug where connection to dedicated server would not be established
Fixed a bug where user could not exit from a game in local mode
Fixed a bug where a web tools window would be shown when starting game
Fixed an issue with duplicate server emit listeners, that caused an issue with messages flooding the application.
Updated dependencies

1.4.4.description: This patch contains a lot of performance fixed. An attempt to make the game less resource heavy on older machines.

bugFixes.description: Updated dependencies
Compressed images
Removed unused resources
Load views only when they are used
Removed modal animation
Remove unused (hidden) SVG elements
Remove SVG element duplicates
Code refactorization

news.title: See region bonus
news.description: Now it will be much easier to see a region troop bonus, you can hover over the region in the list in the popup and they will be highlighted on the map.

1.4.2.description: Fixed some issues that were introduced with patch 1.4.1

news.title: Mac support
news.description: From now on there will also be a Mac dist with each release. Players playing on Windows computers will be able to play against opponents on Mac computers.

news.title: Improved randomness
news.description: Experimenting with a new algorithm used for randomness which affect the dice rolls.

news.title: Dice color
news.description: You can now set your preferred dice color in Settings. This will also be used in multiplayer.

news.title: Visual improvmenets
news.description: Interface improvements for the attack modal.

bugFixes.title: Small screen support
bugFixes.description: Fixed an issue where the interface would not scale well on screens with lower resolutions.

bugFixes.title: Server bug fixed
bugFixes.description: Fixed a bug where the server would crash when playing an online game with AI:s

1.4.1.description: This patch contains lots of improvements, bug fixes and new added features.

news.title: Additional maps
news.description: The ability to play on other maps other than the classic map has been added. Two new maps are now available for both singleplayer and multiplayer; Classic world map extended and Napoleonic era Europe map. More maps will soon come!

news.title: More customization options
news.description: There are more character customization options available now.

news.title: Leaderboard enabled
news.description: You can now view the leaderboard. You have to have completed at least ONE multiplayer game to be able to get a ranking and appear on the leaderboard.

news.title: Character gallery
news.description: Added a gallery where you can see all the characters created by the community.

news.title: Fast dice
news.description: In the settings menu you can now enable fast dice mode. This will make the dice roll almost immediately, saving precious time for those who are impatient.

news.title: Default settings
news.description: Added the ability to reset settings to default. The default settings are the ones recommended for this game.

news.title: Added quick link to report bug site
news.description: Check the top right corner for the little bug icon. This will open the projects Github page where you can submit bugs. Feel free to also submit suggestions and feedback.

news.title: Visual improvements
news.description: Lots of graphical improvements to the game view.
subPoints: Replaced the turn timer in multiplayer games.
Also warn a player in multiplayer games if the time is almost up
Adjusted the speed of AI opponents in multiplayer games.
Added ability to see the bonuses for controlling whole regions.
Made it more visibly obvious when other players or AI:s are attacking or performing movements in mulitplayer games by drawing arrows between territories on the map.

bugFixes.description: Fixed a bug where the tutorial would not work properly.
Fixed a bug where player could not choose their character in a multiplayer lobby.
Fixed a bug where a player could not set a default character.
Fixed a bug where players could see other players cards in mulitplayer games.
Fixed a bug where players could not select their custom created characters.
Fixed a bug where the game announcer voice would not speak.
Fixed a bug where it wasn't possible to change a player to AI in a singleplayer lobby.
Fixed a bug where players couldn't see newly created multiplayer lobbies.
